central_conjecture.name: Leading-Digit Hailstone Conjecture
central_conjecture.statement: Every positive integer eventually enters the distinguished 7-cycle.

adversarial_summary.elementary_fact: For every m>=1, some positive odd seed has at least m consecutive initial accelerated steps with exact v2=1.

final_declared_stage_1_campaign.theorem_level_red_team_result: For every k>=0, n=2*10^k-1 has leading digit 1 and odd-branch numerator 6*10^k=3*2^(k+1)*5^k, hence valuation exactly k+1 and accelerated successor 3*5^k.
final_declared_stage_1_campaign.limitation: All convergence findings are finite exact computation over declared protocols; the central conjecture remains unproved.

pilot_gate_basis: The statement is elementary to state and the full map has nontrivial decimal-sector, 2-adic, inverse, cycle-equation, and arbitrarily-long weak-division structure.
Exact finite testing through 5000000 found no competing positive cycle and gives a minimum-element exclusion for any different positive cycle in that range.

The predeclared nearby family is behaviorally mixed: all four nonfrozen global shifts have multiple observed cycles through 1000000, while all seven one-coordinate perturbations that were one-cycle at 100000 remain one-cycle through 1000000.

Targeted falsification did not break the frozen conjecture: all 9000 boundary-adjacent seeds through exponent 500 entered the distinguished cycle, as did explicit residue-lifted starts with at least 30, 50, and 100 consecutive initial v2=1 accelerated steps.
Arbitrarily long initial v2=1 runs exist by an elementary construction, so local growth stretches cannot be ruled out by a uniform bound.
The distinguished 7-cycle is old 5x+1 behavior and is not evidence of novelty.
Current prior-art work has not located an exact or mathematically equivalent full-map construction, but negative search evidence is insufficient for a novelty claim.

elementary_facts: If M is the minimum odd state of a cycle then 1 < 2^R/3^q <= (1+19/(3M))^q.
For odd x>19, accelerated r=1 steps strictly increase and r>=2 steps strictly decrease.
A large accelerated-cycle minimum leaves with r=1 and is entered with r>=2.
After s consecutive r=1 steps, one-step return to the pre-run height requires 2^(r+s)>3^(s+1).
For a one-rise/one-fall accelerated cycle above 19, the valuation word is equivalent to exactly one strict local minimum and one strict local maximum; a unique global minimum alone is not sufficient.
One-rise/one-fall cycles satisfy the period-independent product envelope 1 < 2^R/3^q <= M(M-19)/(M^2-57M+361).
If E is the sum over falling steps of (r_i-2), then R=2q-a+E and a-E=2q-R.
Farey-neighbour upper/lower approximations to log_2(3) transfer a record product ratio across a complete denominator block, avoiding period-by-period scanning.

For M>=5000001, if t=log(2^R/3^q)>0 satisfies the structured product window then M<39/t; for a determinant-one final Farey neighbour pair before the next upper record this gives M_max<39*q_next/log(2).

Finite-range decimal-boundary localization: through s exact r=1 rises on [L,U], at most 20*J_s(L,U)+1 decimal-sector words occur, where J_s counts relevant scaled decimal boundaries; for fixed [L,U], J_s=O(s).
For a fixed exact-r=1 rise digit word with affine term A_s, all s parity conditions are equivalent to 3^s M + A_s == 2^s (mod 2^(s+1)), hence M == 3^(-s)(2^s-A_s) (mod 2^(s+1)).

For a fixed exact-r=1 rise word, the unique residues satisfy rho_(s+1)=rho_s+b_s*2^(s+1); the lift bits b_s are exactly the successive binary digits of the required starting residue above its forced odd bit.
Bounded-range residue locking: for starts M<=U, at B=floor(log_2 U) the congruence forces M=rho_B, and every later compatible lift bit is zero.

Combining bit-length locking with decimal-boundary localization gives at most 180*B*(ceil(log_10((U+19)/L))+1)+1 starts surviving B rises in [L,U]; for fixed L this is O((log U)^2) candidate compression.

After locking, x_s=1+2H_s exactly, and b_s=0 is equivalent to the deterministic accelerated numerator at x_s having valuation one; hence symbolic lift/decimal branching is unnecessary after lock depth.

Post-lock normalized corridor: if X_0=X and 2 X_(j+1)=3 X_j+c_j with 3<=c_j<=19 through an exact-r=1 tail, then Z_j=(2/3)^j X_j satisfies Z_(j+1)-Z_j=(c_j/3)(2/3)^j and 3(1-(2/3)^t)<=Z_t-X<=19(1-(2/3)^t)<19.

Post-lock decimal-boundary corridor: if the actual leading digit at time t differs from that of the homogeneous rational (3/2)^t X, some decimal boundary C=d*10^k satisfies the exact integer inequality X*3^t<C*2^t<(X+19)*3^t.

Exact-r=1 same-sector control: a decimal sector with leading digit d>=2 is exited after one step; the digit-1 sector supplies at most two consecutive source states; six consecutive exact-r=1 steps cross at least one power-of-ten boundary.

stage_1_progress.proof_direction_update: Post-lock decimal geometry now has two complementary width-19 coordinates. The forward normalized corridor keeps (2/3)^t x_t in a fixed interval above the lock state. For any fixed finite exact-r=1 segment, the terminally anchored guide g_s=x_N(2/3)^(N-s) stays less than 19 above every earlier x_s in absolute distance. Any disagreement with either corresponding homogeneous digit itinerary is localized to an explicit width-19 decimal-boundary window. The exact own-bit scan through B=220 still has maximum observed tail 6 and no forward-corridor digit mismatch in any positive tail. No F(B) or F(M) theorem follows; the sharper target remains scale-aware parity/congruence control along a phase-frozen digit itinerary.

formalisation_summary.domain_convention: Definitions are total on Nat; mathematical dynamics are on n>0, with PositiveNat={n : Nat // 0<n} available as an equivalent domain wrapper.

leading_digit.definition: leadingDigit n = if n=0 then 0 else n/(10^(Nat.log 10 n))

formalisation_summary.map: T n = n/2 when n%2=0, otherwise 3*n+2*leadingDigit n+1; T preserves positivity.
formalisation_summary.cycle_interface: Each edge and seven-step closure are formally checked; membership is invariant under T and under all later iterates.
formalisation_summary.central_conjecture: def LeadingDigitHailstoneConjecture : Prop := forall n : Nat, 0<n -> exists k : Nat, inDistinguishedCycle ((T^[k]) n)
formalisation_summary.positive_domain_equivalence: The Nat-plus-positivity conjecture is formally equivalent to the PositiveNat formulation.
formalisation_summary.organisation: Core specification remains in Basic.lean; the independent theorem-level valuation-burst proof is in ValuationBurst.lean, with root Challenge/Solution modules for Palomar.
formalisation_summary.deliberately_unformalised: Large finite computational certificates and the enormous structured-cycle frontier remain reproducible computational evidence rather than Lean proof obligations.

stage_2_exit_gate.interpretation: Stage 2 is a formal-specification completion gate, not a proof of the Leading-Digit Hailstone Conjecture.

stage_3_preparation.theorem_scope: For every k>=0, n=2*10^k-1 has decimal-sector bounds for leading digit 1, odd numerator 6*10^k=3*2^(k+1)*5^k, exact divisibility by 2^(k+1) but not 2^(k+2), and accelerated quotient 3*5^k.
